products.name: Shutter Motor
products.summary: Fully copper-wound roller shutter motor with overheat protection and mechanical limit switches.
intro: A heavy-duty roller shutter motor built for long service life. The winding is made entirely of copper for higher capacity and more durable use, and every unit carries built-in protection and manual control.

features.title: All-copper motor
features.text: The motor is made entirely of copper, giving it a higher capacity and more durable use.

features.title: Overheat protection
features.text: A built-in mechanism protects the motor: the power supply is switched off immediately if the temperature reaches 110 °C, and the motor works again once it has dropped to 70 °C.

features.title: Mechanical limit switch
features.text: Precisely and safely adjusts the door position in both the up and down directions, with a stability control feature that can be operated remotely.

features.title: Manual button
features.text: Up / Stop / Down control for opening and closing the rolling door.

stock.title: Ready stock
stock.note: Available in single and three phase.

images.alt: Shutter motor with remote controllers, control box and chain drive

products.keywords: roller shutter rolling door kehong copper

products.name: Parking Barriers
products.summary: Automatic barrier systems that regulate vehicle entry and exit for car parks and restricted areas.
intro: Parking barriers are an essential component in managing and controlling access to parking lots, garages and restricted areas. These automated systems regulate the entry and exit of vehicles, ensuring security, proper management of parking spaces and smooth traffic flow.

features.title: Automated operation
features.text: Parking barriers are usually equipped with advanced automation that allows seamless operation. The barrier arm rises or lowers automatically when a vehicle approaches, triggered by sensors, ticketing systems or remote access controls.

features.title: ANPR integration
features.text: Some systems integrate with Automatic Number Plate Recognition technology, allowing frictionless access based on the vehicle’s registration plate.

products.name: M-Driver Motor VFD
products.summary: Variable frequency drives to control motor speed, frequency and direction of rotation.
intro: Variable Frequency Drives (VFDs) are used with motors to control their speed and direction. If a motor is running clockwise, a VFD lets you operate it anticlockwise as well.

features.title: Control speed

features.title: Control frequency
features.text: Set and change the frequency supplied to the motor.

features.title: Reverse direction
features.text: Run the motor in either direction.

features.title: Timed start / stop
features.text: Set a timer for the motor to stop or start.

products.name: Infrared Sensors
products.summary: Infrared sensors that detect heat or motion for security and automatic door applications.
intro: An infrared sensor (IR sensor) is an electronic device that detects and measures infrared radiation — a type of electromagnetic radiation invisible to the human eye — allowing it to sense heat or motion from objects in its surroundings.
Commonly used in applications like motion detectors, night-vision equipment, remote controls and security systems.
